name: Deterministic Capability Policy Gateway
mechanism: Intercepts every proposed tool or peer-agent action and evaluates canonical identity, delegation, operation, resource, arguments, risk and budget before execution.
use_when: Model output can cause external actions or data access
Multiple tools or agents need one enforceable policy boundary
avoid_when: The workload has no tool data or external-action authority
The gateway cannot observe or block every execution path
expected_effects: Central audit and revocation point for agent actions
failure_modes: A tool bypasses the gateway through a direct client
Policy outage or error fails open
